probes.prompt: I just made my final commit on my branch and am ready for review. What exact git command and JSON schema should I use to attach Hunk agent notes to HEAD? Do not run it.
probes.why: Attaching Hunk agent notes on HEAD must load hunk-notes and state the git notes --ref=hunk command.

probes.prompt: How should I anchor and attach Hunk review notes for a deletion-only hunk on my branch before opening the PR?
probes.why: Deletion-only hunk anchor rule must stay preserved after body cut.

probes.prompt: Open the live Hunk window and jump to file 3 hunk 2.
probes.why: Driving a live Hunk window belongs to hunk-review, not hunk-notes.
